proposals.title: Stockholder Proposal—Right to Call Special Meeting
proposals.topic_summary: Asks the board to amend governing documents to give owners of a combined 10% of outstanding common stock the power to call a special shareholder meeting.
proposals.evidence: The Board recommends you vote AGAINST this proposal for the following reasons:

proposals.title: Stockholder Proposal—Emissions Reduction Targets
proposals.proponent: Follow This, on behalf of Benta B.V.
proposals.topic_summary: Requests the company set and publish short, medium and long-term targets to reduce GHG emissions from operations and energy products (Scope 1, 2, and 3) consistent with the Paris Agreement.
proposals.evidence: For the foregoing reasons, the Board recommends you vote AGAINST this proposal.

proposals.title: Stockholder Proposal—Report on Lobbying Activities
proposals.topic_summary: Requests an annual report disclosing direct and indirect lobbying and grassroots lobbying policies, payments, recipients, and oversight decision-making.
proposals.evidence: For the foregoing reasons, the Board recommends you vote AGAINST this proposal.
